title: Attention-Enriched Deep Learning Model for Breast Tumor Segmentation in Ultrasound Images.
summary: Primary article reports attention-enriched deep-learning breast-ultrasound tumor segmentation; the salient attention model reaches Dice 90.5% on 510 images and is compared with model variants. This is a bounded medical-image segmentation result; external-site/clinical workflow validation is not established.
